protocol.cohort: The same 35 tasks with eligible saved outputs by both 30 and 120 active minutes in the longer Codex runs. All compared curves use these tasks.
protocol.selection: Best recorded mean ADD by each trial completion time. Equal task weights.
protocol.missingness: Each method mean starts when all 35 tasks have eligible outputs. No zero imputation or backfilling.
protocol.budget_axis: Elapsed active worker minutes multiplied by worker count, divided by 60. This measures allocated agent-hours, not token consumption.
protocol.semantic: Existing final judgments over all 40 tasks; no intermediate semantic judgments inferred.
